description: Get precomputed aggregate financial statistics for a sector, region, PKD branch, or country. Returns median, p25/p75/p90, winsorized mean, mean, total, n_companies, min/max. Use for questions like: what is the median revenue / average profit / assets in industry X or region Y? Prefer median or winsor_mean over mean. cost_wages is PLN-only.

dimension_key.description: Key for the dimension, e.g. 'PL', 'G', '46', '46.90.Z', 'mazowieckie'. Prefix match applied.

metric.description: Financial metric. Omit to return all metrics.

name: get_financial_stats
title: Get Sector Financial Statistics
